title: Start here: from an empty machine to a running platform
excerpt: Two repositories, three commands: born2root builds the virtual machine, Inception runs ten containers inside it, and your browser opens https://dlesieur.42.fr.

title: The machine underneath: why everything starts with Born2beRoot
excerpt: A Debian server on an encrypted disk, installed without a single question and sized from one number. What the virtual machine is, and why Inception runs on it.

title: nginx, the only door
excerpt: One port, TLS 1.2 and 1.3 only, and a routing table that sends each path to the container that owns it. How the edge is set up, and what it refuses.

title: Docker, the way this stack uses it
excerpt: Built, not pulled. One daemon per container, as PID 1. Data in named volumes, passwords in files. The rules behind the ten containers, and why each one exists.

title: Credentials: where they live and how they move
excerpt: From a secrets file on the host to /run/secrets in a container, without ever passing through an environment variable or a command line, and what guards the sign-in page.

title: Maintaining the site: a post, a wiki page, a diagram
excerpt: Sign in, write, publish. How a maintainer adds to the blog and the wiki, draws a diagram, and how what is written in wp-admin and what comes from the repository live side by side.
